description: Rule 47: RouteContactToAgent (the Interrupt agent block) in a customer queue flow with Parameters empty, rule 40's probe rerun on the sandbox. Rule 40's run on another instance (us-east-1, 2026-10-05) was refused as "Invalid Action type". If this one is refused naming a required parameter, the Type exists and the message names its first key; if it is refused as an invalid type again, the page's spelling or a feature the instance lacks is the question, and an export settles it.
